answer: Sequential time is the toll. Each epoch the node publishes a seed, and every key must run 2^32 chained squarings before it may answer; the proof checks in a millisecond, yet the chain cannot be split across machines or bought in bulk. Ten thousand duplicates need ten thousand separate seventy-minute runs, about 11,700 core-hours, near $420 per epoch at $0.036 per core-hour on spot capacity. One skipped link voids the key's collateral. A bad actor holds a lantern over a hall of idle CPUs and a jetty of stalled queues, while one honest agent catches a single gale of heat and is done.
